Valmiel dispute
nodes.evidence: Le curé de Valmiel réclame en 1398 la cire d'un essaim posé dans le clocher.
nodes.rationale: Fictional 1398 dispute: the parish priest of Valmiel claims the wax of a swarm that settled in the bell tower.

nodes.label: Swarm ownership
nodes.evidence: Le juré des ruchers juge que l'essaim est au curé, mais que la cire de la première année revient à l'apiculteur
nodes.rationale: Ruling: the swarm belongs to the priest (owner of the bell tower where it settled), but the first-year wax goes to the beekeeper who pursued it.

nodes.label: Beeswax
nodes.evidence: la cire de la première année revient à l'apiculteur qui l'avait suivi au chaudron
nodes.rationale: First-year wax awarded to the pursuing beekeeper; half of the wax goes to the church candles.

nodes.rationale: The beekeeper followed the swarm beating a cauldron; this pursuit grounds his right to the first-year wax.
